signals.title_en: QR pays someone other than the named seller
signals.title_ne: QR ले बिक्रेताको नामभन्दा फरक व्यक्तिलाई पैसा पठाउँछ
signals.explanation_en: The QR code pays "SITA SHARMA", but the chat/listing uses "KTM Mobile Hub". Your money goes to whoever is named in the QR — not to the page name you see in the chat.
signals.explanation_ne: QR ले "SITA SHARMA" लाई पैसा पठाउँछ, तर च्याट/विज्ञापनमा "KTM Mobile Hub" नाम छ। तपाईंको पैसा च्याटमा देखिएको पेजको नाममा होइन, QR मा लेखिएको व्यक्तिकहाँ जान्छ।
unknowns_en: Whether the seller personally owns this account
signals.not_always_scam_en: Small shops often use the owner's personal account. Ask who the account belongs to before paying.

signals.explanation_en: The seller changed the payment method from Cash on Delivery to a 50% advance payment requirement.
signals.explanation_ne: विक्रेताले भुक्तानीको तरिका COD बाट ५०% अग्रिम भुक्तानीमा परिवर्तन गरे।
unknowns_en: Reason why COD was suddenly stopped
signals.not_always_scam_en: Prices and stock genuinely change. What matters is whether the change is explained and you still have a safe option.

signals.quote: Advance 50% pathaunus ani matra dispatch huncha
signals.explanation_en: The seller is asking for a partial payment before the item is dispatched.
signals.explanation_ne: सामान पठाउनु अघि विक्रेताले ५०% अग्रिम भुक्तानी मागेका छन्।
unknowns_en: Seller's physical location or shop existence
signals.not_always_scam_en: Some honest sellers ask for an advance on custom or pre-order items. Look at it together with other signals.

signals.title_en: Refuses cash on delivery or any way to verify
signals.title_ne: COD वा प्रमाणित गर्ने उपाय अस्वीकार
signals.explanation_en: The seller refuses the buyer's request for Cash on Delivery.
signals.explanation_ne: विक्रेताले खरिदकर्ताको COD को अनुरोध अस्वीकार गरे।
signals.not_always_scam_en: Small sellers sometimes stop COD after bad experiences. Ask for an alternative way to verify.

signals.explanation_en: The seller is using the threat of running out of stock to pressure the buyer into paying immediately.
signals.explanation_ne: स्टक सकिन लागेको भन्दै विक्रेताले तुरुन्तै पैसा पठाउन दबाब दिए।
signals.not_always_scam_en: Real sales also say "limited stock". On its own this is weak; it matters more combined with advance payment.

next_steps.text_en: Ask the seller to explain whose account this is. Before paying, check the name shown in your wallet's confirmation screen.
next_steps.text_ne: यो खाता कसको हो भनी बिक्रेतालाई सोध्नुहोस्। पैसा पठाउनुअघि वालेटको पुष्टि स्क्रिनमा देखिएको नाम जाँच्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Screenshot both the earlier and the later message before continuing.
next_steps.text_ne: अगाडि र पछाडिको दुवै म्यासेजको स्क्रिनसट राख्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Ask the seller to honour the original terms in writing.
next_steps.text_ne: सुरुमा भनिएको सर्त नै लिखित रूपमा पालना गर्न अनुरोध गर्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Ask if cash on delivery (COD) is possible. If not, ask why.
next_steps.text_ne: क्यास अन डेलिभरी (COD) मिल्छ कि मिल्दैन सोध्नुहोस्। मिल्दैन भने किन, त्यो पनि सोध्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Check the seller's page history, reviews and whether others have bought from them.
next_steps.text_ne: बिक्रेताको पेजको इतिहास, रिभ्यु र अरूले किनेका छन् कि छैनन् हेर्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Ask for a live video of the item with today's date written on paper.
next_steps.text_ne: आजको मिति कागजमा लेखेर सामानको लाइभ भिडियो देखाउन अनुरोध गर्नुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Take your time. A genuine seller will usually wait a few hours for you to verify.
next_steps.text_ne: हतार नगर्नुहोस्। साँचो बिक्रेताले जाँच्नका लागि केही घण्टा पर्खन्छन्।

next_steps.text_en: Never share an OTP, PIN or password with a seller.
next_steps.text_ne: बिक्रेतालाई OTP, PIN वा पासवर्ड कहिल्यै नदिनुहोस्।

next_steps.text_en: Before you confirm a payment, check the receiver name your wallet or bank app shows.
next_steps.text_ne: भुक्तानी पुष्टि गर्नुअघि वालेट वा बैंक एपले देखाएको प्राप्तकर्ताको नाम जाँच्नुहोस्।

agent.online_summary_en: No specific scam reports were found for 'KTM Mobile Hub', but no official business verification was available either. The quoted price of Rs 1,15,000 is slightly lower than the official retail price of approximately Rs 1,27,499 in Nepal.
agent.online_summary_ne: 'KTM Mobile Hub' को बारेमा कुनै विशेष स्क्याम रिपोर्ट भेटिएन, तर यसको आधिकारिकता पनि पुष्टि भएन। तपाईंले भन्नुभएको १,१५,००० को मूल्य नेपालको आधिकारिक बजार मूल्य (करिब १,२७,४९९) भन्दा केही कम छ।

scripts.purpose_en: Verify the product's existence and authenticity via live video.
scripts.purpose_ne: सामान वास्तविक हो कि होइन भनेर भिडियो कलबाट हेर्न।
scripts.message_ne: म अगाडि बढ्न तयार छु, तर पहिले एउटा सानो भिडियो कल गरिदिनुहुन्छ कि? फोनको बक्स र मेरो नाम लेखिएको कागज सँगै राखेर आजको मिति देखाएर भिडियो देखाउनुहोस् न।
scripts.message_en: I am ready to proceed, but can we do a quick video call first? Please show the phone box along with a paper with my name and today's date written on it.
scripts.verifies_en: If the seller refuses or provides a pre-recorded video, the risk is extremely high.

scripts.purpose_en: Check if a physical shop visit or open-box COD is possible.
scripts.purpose_ne: पसलमा गएर सामान हेर्न वा सामान खोल्दा पैसा तिर्ने (Open-box COD) सम्भव छ कि छैन भनेर सोध्न।
scripts.message_ne: अगाडि पैसा पठाउन अलि डर लागिरहेको छ। के म तपाईंको पसलमै आएर सामान हेरेर पैसा तिर्न सक्छु? वा सामान ल्याउँदा बक्स खोलेर चेक गरेपछि मात्र पैसा तिर्ने (Open-box COD) व्यवस्था हुन्छ कि?
scripts.message_en: I am a bit hesitant to pay in advance. Can I visit your shop to check the item and pay? Or can we do an open-box COD where I pay only after checking the item?
scripts.verifies_en: A refusal to allow a physical visit or open-box verification is a major red flag.

scripts.purpose_en: Clarify why the payment is going to a personal account.
scripts.purpose_ne: किन व्यक्तिगत नाममा पैसा पठाउनुपर्ने हो भनेर सोध्न।
scripts.message_ne: तपाईंको पसलको नाम 'KTM Mobile Hub' हो, तर QR स्क्यान गर्दा 'SITA SHARMA' भनेर आउँछ। यो पसलको आधिकारिक खाता हो कि व्यक्तिगत हो? किन अगाडि पैसा पठाउनुपर्ने?
scripts.message_en: Your shop name is 'KTM Mobile Hub', but the QR shows 'SITA SHARMA'. Is this an official business account or a personal one? Why is advance payment required?
scripts.verifies_en: If they cannot explain why a personal account is being used for a business transaction, do not proceed.

agent.what_changes_risk_en: If the seller agrees to a physical shop visit or open-box COD, the risk decreases; if they insist on advance payment to a personal account and refuse video verification, the risk is critical.
agent.what_changes_risk_ne: यदि विक्रेताले पसलमा आउन वा सामान खोलेर पैसा तिर्न (Open-box COD) अनुमति दिएमा जोखिम कम हुन्छ; तर यदि व्यक्तिगत खातामा मात्र पैसा पठाउन दबाब दिए र भिडियो देखाउन अस्वीकार गरेमा जोखिम धेरै उच्च हुन्छ।

findings.query: KTM Mobile Hub reviews scam Nepal
findings.summary:
No specific reliable information or widespread scam reports were found regarding a seller named "KTM Mobile Hub" in Nepal. 

While there are general warnings from the Nepal Police Cyber Bureau about online shopping and mobile scams, and mentions of a "Mobile Hub Kathmandu" on Hamrobazar with no ratings, there is no direct evidence linking "KTM Mobile Hub" to fraudulent activity.

The official price for the iPhone 15 128GB in Nepal is reported to be NPR 127,499 by several sources, including Oliz Store and authorized distributor information. Reliable authorized resellers such as EvoStore and Oliz Store provide genuine Apple products with official warranties.

petition.narrative_ne: मैले फेसबुकको Nepal Shoes Corner (नेपाल सुज खन बान) पेजबाट जुत्ता मगाएको थिएँ। उक्त पेजसँग कुराकानी गर्दा तीन दिनभित्र सामान आइपुग्ने भनिएको थियो। सोही अनुसार मैले मिति २०२६-०९-२८ मा ३,२०० रुपैयाँ उक्त व्यक्तिको खातामा पठाएँ। तर, तीन दिनको समय बितिसक्दा पनि सामान प्राप्त भएन र हाल उक्त पेज/व्यक्तिले फोन पनि उठाउनुभएको छैन।

timeline.what_ne: तीन दिनभित्र सामान डेलिभरी गर्ने वाचा गरिएको थियो।

petition.request_ne: उक्त घटनाको आवश्यक छानबिन गरी दोषी उपर कानुनबमोजिम कारबाही गरी मेरो रकम फिर्ता गराइदिनुहुन अनुरोध गर्दछु ।
